fine_trace.note: The glyph-info array is grown with realloc; the entries in [len, new_allocated) are never initialized, so any read beyond the written length is a use of uninitialized value.
Only the entries [0, len) of the input buffer are initialized as Unicode characters are appended; the tail of the array stays uninitialized.
The first (decompose) round expands the buffer: U+0622 (not in the font cmap) decomposes to U+0627 + U+0653, so out_len exceeds idx and make_room_for moves out_info to the separate pos buffer.
After the decompose round, swap_buffers makes out_info point at the original input array, which has only out_len = 16 initialized entries, while the new info buffer has len = 17 entries.

During Arabic mark reordering the glyphs are moved inside buffer->info and merge_out_clusters(start, j) is invoked over the affected range without restricting the operation to the initialized region: j (end of the modifier-combining-mark run, 17) exceeds out_len (16), so the merge examines cluster data of glyph entries whose cluster values were never initialized.
The min-cluster scan reads out_info[i].cluster for i in (start, end); because end (17) is greater than out_len (16), index 16 reads cluster data of a glyph entry that was never initialized.

vuln_logic.issue_alignment: The public issue describes a use of uninitialized value while reordering Arabic combining marks: glyphs are moved within buffer->info and clusters are merged over the affected range via an operation not restricted to initialized cluster information. This matches reorder_marks_arabic calling buffer->merge_out_clusters(start, j) after the normalize decompose round has left out_info pointing at the old input array with only out_len initialized entries, so merge_out_clusters reads out_info[i].cluster past out_len.
